title: Certificates of Deposit: Changing the Maturity Instruction, Interest Choice and Payout Account
content:
Each of Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit carries three standing settings chosen by its owner: what should happen at maturity, where credited interest should go, and which PCB account receives any money paid out. This page states when and how those settings may be changed.

## Who may change them, and when

The owner may alter any of the three settings whenever the certificate stands in active status or is passing through its grace period.

## Timing of a new maturity instruction

The original clause that tied a changed maturity instruction to this maturity only if it was recorded before grace ended, and otherwise to the next maturity, is **no longer in force**; which maturity a changed instruction governs is now set by the current basis for maturity instructions.

## Interest choice

A choice for credited interest must be one of the choices the certificate's tier lists. A new choice applies from the next interest crediting date onward; interest already credited is not re-routed.

## The payout account

The account named as payout account must, at the moment the setting is recorded, be a checking account or a savings account that belongs to the same customer as the certificate and is in active status. The test is made on the bank's records for the named account. An instruction to pay out that names no such account is not accepted.

## Condition, judgement, outcome (hypothetical)

| Account offered as payout account | Judgement | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| The owner's own savings account, active | Same customer, active | Accepted |
| The owner's own checking account, closed last year | Not active | Not accepted |
| An active checking account of the owner's spouse, held in the spouse's name only | Not the same customer | Not accepted |

## Points of judgement

**A certificate has already closed; may its owner still change its interest choice?** No. Changes are open only to a certificate in active status or in grace.

**The owner switches from compounding to having interest paid out on 12 March (hypothetical).** Every crediting from the first crediting date after 12 March onward follows the new choice; credits made before the change stay where they went.

superseded_clauses: A change to the renewal instruction must be recorded before the grace period ends to govern this maturity; a change recorded after that governs the next maturity.
